national.headline: Pakistan Bar Council urges judiciary to ensure Imran Khan's medical treatment.
national.line: Eight PBC members requested courts ensure former premier Imran Khan receives medical care as ordered.

national.headline: PTA approves framework for in-flight internet services.
national.line: Pakistan Telecommunication Authority finalized licensing rules for satellite-based internet and digital services on aircraft.

national.headline: Punjab local government elections set for two phases in 2027.
national.line: The Election Commission of Pakistan agreed to hold local government polls in Punjab in February 2027 over two phases.

national.headline: Pakistan and Turkmenistan discuss TAPI gas pipeline progress.
national.line: Deputy PM Ishaq Dar met Turkmenistan’s Foreign Minister to discuss the Turkmenistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan-India gas pipeline.

national.headline: ADB approves $500 million loan for federal pension reforms.
national.line: The Asian Development Bank approved a $500 million loan to help Pakistan reform its federal civil pension system.

national.headline: Saudi Delta Energy to explore $30 billion energy investment.
national.line: Saudi's Delta Energy will assess a natural gas pipeline project in Pakistan, exploring up to $30 billion in investment.

national.headline: BISP expands financial aid to include unmarried women aged 45+.
national.line: Benazir Income Support Programme now includes unmarried women aged 45 or above in its financial assistance scheme.

national.headline: Nearly 800 Afghan nationals arrested in Pakistan in early November.
national.line: Law enforcement agencies arrested 796 Afghan nationals across Pakistan during the first week of November.

international.headline: Feuds emerge in Trump's White House after midterm elections.
international.line: Rifts over China, AI, and Iran, along with personal rivalries, have surfaced in President Trump's White House.

international.headline: UK sanctions Israeli firms involved in West Bank settlements.
international.line: Britain imposed sanctions on eight Israeli companies for planning and building West Bank settlements to halt new construction.

international.headline: Pakistan enhances defence cooperation with UK and Turkiye.
international.line: Field Marshal Asim Munir discussed strengthening defence cooperation with army chiefs from the United Kingdom and Turkiye.

international.headline: Bangladesh garment workers clash with police during wage protests.
international.line: Police used tear gas against thousands of garment workers protesting after a key wage board meeting was postponed.

international.headline: Pakistan and Iran emphasize regional peace and stability.
international.line: CDF Asim Munir met Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, stressing mutual trust and coordination for regional peace.

international.headline: Pakistan condemns Israeli attacks in Syria.
international.line: Pakistan condemned Israel’s continued attacks in Syrian territory, urging an immediate end to violations and withdrawal.

international.headline: US and Russia to oppose new rules for autonomous weapons.
international.line: Major arms producers the US and Russia will likely resist legally binding rules for autonomous weapons at a Geneva meeting.

international.headline: Pakistani minister to attend SCO dialogue in New Delhi.
international.line: Pakistan will send a minister to the SCO Civilisational Dialogue in New Delhi, sparking hopes for improved relations.
